assertion: PR #428's original text asserted that the official BGE-M3 sparse head should be a [250002,1024] projection and treated a published [1,1024] sparse_linear weight as a stub proving the trained head was absent.
correction: FlagEmbedding's official implementation defines Linear(hidden_size, 1), applies ReLU to one scalar per token, then scatters/max-reduces by input_ids into vocabulary IDs. For hidden_size 1024, [1,1024] is the expected linear weight shape; shape and file size alone do not prove trained weights are absent or random.
scope: Architecture mechanism in the official FlagEmbedding source at commit 6eefbac0e0c185205fe210b999a4cbe55c97054e; affected historical text is docs/RESEARCH.md §§2.1.0a and 2.1.0b.
protocol: Retrospective static source review, accessed 2026-10-07. No model weights were downloaded, no model was run, and no historical export was retested.
limits: This establishes the implementation's projection/aggregation mechanism, not whether a particular published checkpoint contains trained parameters.
It does not validate any ONNX export or historical measurement.
